Just4%ofthejournalistsmentioned workforanyprint outlet. The storyinFrance isvery similar, with,if anything,an evengreater focus onTV news presenters.Ninein tenjournalists named in Franceworkinbroadcastmedia,primarilyattelevisionoutlets suchasTF1andFranceTélevisions-whichreceived23%and21% Pascal Praud and Anne-Claire Coudray.AsinBrazil,journalists fromnationalnewspaperslikeLeMondeandLeFigaroarerarely mentioned,withonly6%of names comingfromprintmedia.
